question: What is the meaning of functional unit in relation to physical composition?
description: The functional unit in relation to physical composition refers to the specific characteristics and properties of a material or component, such as its mass, dimensions, and resistance to deformation. This information is crucial for understanding how different materials and components interact and function together within a product or structure. In the context of sustainable construction and circularity, knowing the functional unit of materials and components can help optimize their selection, processing, and assembly, as well as facilitate their separation, dismantling, and recycling at the end of life of a product.

3.1.3
Composition properties
Figure 5 shows the composition property facet. This block of ontology helps to optimise
the selection, processing, and assembly of the constituent parts and materials of a product
and facilitates their separation, dismantling, and recycling at the end of life of a product
to maximise the circularity.
Figure 5: Composition property facet of the MPO.
CompositionProperty has two subclasses, ConstituentPart and ConstituentMaterial. For
example, crossbeam has constituent materials carbon fibre, glass fibre, epoxy resin, alu-
minium, foam, and film adhesive that have mass, and a source and destination in a circular
economy.
